title: drug-response-transferability: analysis code and results for cross-assay concordance and the transferability of drug-response models
description: Python code, result tables and split identifiers for a study of whether the agreement between two drug-sensitivity assays (CTRP, GDSC2, PRISM) on shared cancer cell lines predicts how well expression-based drug-response models transfer between assays. Input data are public and are not redistributed; the README lists their sources and versions.
